integrity: The defining Rota-Baxter equations are reconstructed directly from the multiplication e1e1=e3 and the source matrix convention. A concrete source-family counterexample is checked over Q, and exhaustive finite-field replay over F2 and F3 independently confirms the corrected counts and rank distributions.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns only the A2 row of the three-dimensional Zinbiel Rota-Baxter table.
No claim is made about the other rows of the source classification.
The finite-field extension follows from a fresh polynomial derivation; an unindexed independent correction may exist.
title: Corrected Rota–Baxter locus for the three-dimensional Zinbiel algebra \(A_2\)
